title: feat(cron): recover interrupted one-shot jobs on restart

commit.messageHeadline: feat(cron): recover interrupted one-shot jobs on restart
fix(cron): preserve terminal outcomes through scheduler retirement
fix(cron): settle retired manual runs with exact receipts
fix(cron): retain receipts after failed manual outcome writes
fix(cron): reconcile recovery and finalization invariants

atomic cron run recovery - PASS `expect_output`: one-shot recovery when ## How this fits together Cron stores schedules, execution receipts, and task history in SQLite. Gateway startup repairs interrupted work, then the scheduler admits any due catch-up occurrence and records its terminal outcome. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Stored cron job] --> B[Gateway restart] B --> C[Receipt and task-history recovery] C --> D[Pending catch-up or terminal repair] D --> E[Scheduler admission] E --> F[Job execution] F --> G[Receipt and task outcome] ``` ## Before merge - [ ] **Record the removed run before settling its receipt (P2)** - The new missing-job branch settles the receipt before `emitMissingTerminal(true)`. `finishCronRunReceipt` queues a retry and throws on a database failure, so queued manual execution reaches `enqueueRun`’s outer catch and records an error even when the payload completed successfully. Emit the exact terminal task result first, then add the combined removal and receipt-write-failure regression. - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - A concurrent cross-service removal plus a receipt-write failure can report a completed queued manual run as an error; this corrupts the task ledger’s terminal outcome. - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - The captured context has no independently inspectable exact-head test output; the PR-body validation claims remain supplemental until fresh checks complete. - [ ] **Complete next step (P2)** - This maintainer-labeled PR needs a narrow P2 lifecycle correction and fresh exact-head validation rather than repair-lane dispatch. - [ ] **Improve patch quality** - Address the highest-priority review finding and re-run the changed-surface validation. ## Findings - [P2] Record the removed run before settling its receipt — `src/cron/service/ops-run.ts:268-270`
